Topic 1.1: Elements of a map - Title - Frame - Scale - Compass - Key
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Elements of a map - Title - Frame - Scale - Compass - Key, part of Natural and the Built Environments Elements of a Map (3 lessons) Location, posit in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we use maps in our daily lives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Elements of a map - Title - Frame - Scale - Compass - Key together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: digital technology as learners play computer games in groups, on the elements of a map.

● Creativity and imagination: unique ideas as learners draw a sketch map and label the key elements.

Values:
● Respect: accommodating diverse opinions as learners brainstorm in pairs the key elements of a map.

● Unity: taking turns as learners in groups, play computer games on the elements of a map.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Life skills: as learners discuss the various areas where maps are used in their daily lives.

Link to other learning areas:

● Kenyan Sign Language and English: learners use language skills as they brainstorm in pairs the key elements of a map.

● Creative arts: learners apply to skills learnt in Creative Arts as they draw a sketch map and label the key elements.

Suggested Learning Resources:

print and electronic maps, KSL dictionary, sketch maps, wall maps, computers, laptops, approved textbooks, sketch maps, a compass,
